name: Make Yourself at Home
thesis: Raygen's portfolio becomes a personal plum-colored desktop, with real projects open in warm, slightly unruly windows.
interaction: Open project files from the dock, switch between SERV0 and DAVID, remove SERV0's panels, read Stardance notes, drag or close windows, and tidy the desktop with one click.
why: The purple cat avatar, actual printer renders, and Hack Club flag become the contents of Raygen's own little operating system—an inviting place to explore what he makes and cares about.
